goal: 3D mobile viewer real manifest in mobile/lib/features/urn_viewer/ and public/models/.
summary: Implemented full published 3D/2D manifest integration across the Flutter mobile client (mobile/lib/features/urn_viewer/) and static delivery endpoints. Synchronized canonical manifests for all 9 urns (162 hotspots, 18 per urn) from public/models/manifests/ to mobile/assets/data/manifests/ and backend/assets/models/manifests/. Created UrnManifest domain entity, UrnManifestParser, UrnManifestRepository (supporting local asset bundle and remote HTTP fallback), and RubbingFallbackView with InteractiveViewer zoom/pan, archival notice banner ('Mô hình 3D đang phục chế · Bản dập 2D thay thế'), and 18-motif exploration. Enhanced UrnViewerScreen to evaluate device memory and thermal budgets (selecting low LOD -512 on <=3GB RAM, and degrading to 2D rubbing on <=1GB RAM), detect missing meshes (8 of 9 urns), degrade cleanly on WebGL context loss or load error, and offer an instant 2D/3D mode switch. Enforced strict negative abuse guardrails ensuring missing GLBs fall back to licensed HMCC 2D rubbings, never fictional 3D shapes or phantom assets.
invariants_enforced: REAL_MANIFEST_CONSUMPTION: Mobile urn viewer consumes canonical published manifests with 18 spatial coordinates per urn across all 9 urns (162 total), replacing hardcoded Cao Đỉnh assumptions.

DEVICE_THERMAL_AND_MEMORY_CONSTRAINTS: Mobile viewer checks device RAM (DeviceInfoPlugin / meminfo) and thermal constraints. High RAM (>4GB) selects 2k LOD, medium RAM (3-4GB) selects 1k LOD, low RAM (<=3GB) selects 512 LOD (~5.2MB), and severe constraints (<=1GB) cleanly degrade to 2D rubbing view.

FAIL_SAFE_2D_RUBBING_DEGRADATION: Urns with missing meshes (8 of 9 urns), model load errors, or WebGL context loss events automatically degrade to licensed 2D rubbing fallback view without dead screens or unhandled exceptions.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_ZERO_PHANTOM_ASSETS: Missing GLBs or missing meshes strictly reject phantom 3D URLs and fictional 3D shapes (no dummy cubes, spheres, or cross-urn substitution). Must display genuine licensed HMCC 2D rubbings.

EQUAL_LEARNING_OUTCOMES: All 18 motifs in 2D rubbing mode remain fully interactive for discovery (+25 XP), lessons, and quizzes, ensuring zero pedagogical degradation for students on constrained devices.

MULTI_PLATFORM_MANIFEST_PARITY: Manifests in public/models/manifests/, frontend/public/models/manifests/, mobile/assets/data/manifests/, and backend/assets/models/manifests/ maintain byte-for-byte structural consistency.

audit_findings_9_urns_162_hotspots.rights_owner: Trung tâm Bảo tồn Di tích Cố đô Huế (HMCC)

changes.description: Created domain entities for 3D/2D manifests: UrnMeshStatus, UrnLod, UrnViewerFallback, UrnManifestHotspot, and UrnManifest with spatial lookup methods.
Implemented UrnManifestParser deserializing raw manifest JSON into typed domain entities with full coordinate and fallback parsing.
Implemented UrnManifestRepository loading bundled assets from assets/data/manifests/ and falling back to remote endpoint with in-memory caching.
Created RubbingFallbackView with InteractiveViewer pan/zoom on authentic HMCC rubbings, archival reconstruction banner, 18-motif exploration drawer, and 3D toggle.
Integrated UrnManifest, memory/thermal budgeting, 2D rubbing fallback view, WebGL context loss recovery, top bar 2D/3D mode toggles, and genuine 18-hotspot coordinates for all 9 urns.
Added has3dMesh (true only for Cao Đỉnh) and prevented constructing phantom remoteModelUrl for missing urns.
Added has3dMesh and eliminated phantom 3D GLB fallback URL for missing urns.
Exported urnManifestProvider and urnManifestRepositoryProvider for clean Riverpod consumption.
Registered - assets/data/manifests/ under assets for offline bundled manifest access.
Added manifestsAssetsUrl and urnManifest endpoint helpers.
Synchronized all 9 urn manifests and index.json into backend assets directory for FastAPI static serving.
Synchronized all 9 urn manifests and index.json into mobile assets directory for offline Flutter client bundling.

Created comprehensive 21-test suite verifying manifest synchronization, 162-hotspot coordinates, mesh status, LODs, 2D fallback coverage, memory budgeting, negative abuse guardrails, mobile code contracts, and static HTTP serving.

test_details.name: test_all_162_hotspots_have_verified_2d_rubbing_fallback
